subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

In 1920s, new technology __has allowed__ filmmakers to attach to each film a soundtrack of speech.
solution:
The correct answer is:** allowed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Allow **(verb) means to give permission for somebody/so
